preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= T[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each city's building type T[i] must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 10**9 for _, _, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road's crowd value u must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= k <= n for x, y, k in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's x, y, and k must be valid city indices and k must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(path for path in paths if len(set(T[i] for i in path)) >= k) else min(max(u for _, _, u in roads) for path in paths if len(set(T[i] for i in path)) >= k)
postconditions.description: If no valid path exists, print -1; otherwise, print the minimum crowd value of a path with at least k unique building types.
